name: Speak with Gramma
label: Quest
description: This errand sends an adventurer to Gramma Stonefield on behalf of her grandson Tommy Joe. Caught in a bitter feud between the Stonefield and Maclure…
intro: This errand sends an adventurer to Gramma Stonefield on behalf of her grandson Tommy Joe. Caught in a bitter feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families, Tommy Joe hopes the elderly matriarch knows a way he can see Maybell Maclure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please, friend, talk with my Gramma. If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.
She's inside our house east of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't wait to hear how my friends react!

clips.title: Completion
paras: While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... Maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
